question: Is the exact-head immutable reconciliation and final release-candidate replay sufficient to adopt this new fail-closed release provenance contract?
rationale: Code review found no narrow patch defect, but the PR intentionally changes release inventory, tooling trust, and operator semantics and explicitly defers landing until release-owner proof is attached.

options.title: Require exact-head replay
options.body: Keep the draft on hold until successful immutable reconciliation and final release-candidate replay artifacts are attached for the current head.

options.title: Accept current evidence
options.body: Release owners may explicitly accept the new contract from source review and focused validation without the promised final replay.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head replay
recommendation.body: Keep the draft on hold until successful immutable reconciliation and final release-candidate replay artifacts are attached for the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent substantial ownership of the verifier and release-rendering pipeline makes Peter Steinberger the strongest available decision route.
